patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Freshchat and LiveChat share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Freshchat only if your buying job matches “Freshworks live chat — free up to 10 agents; Growth $19, Pro $49, Enterprise $79 agent/mo ” rather than LiveChat's shape. Choose LiveChat only if your buying job matches “Established live chat from Text — Starter $19, Team $49, Business $79, Enterprise $52 per ” rather than Freshchat's shape. Workflow advantage: Freshchat leans ai-customer-service; LiveChat leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Freshchat and LiveChat share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Freshchat is Freshworks live chat — free up to 10 agents; Growth $19, Pro $49, Enterprise $79 agent/mo annual. Primary live-chat; CS secondary.; LiveChat is Established live chat from Text — Starter $19, Team $49, Business $79, Enterprise $52 per person/mo annual. Primary live-chat; CS secondary..
- Company-size focus: Freshchat (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs LiveChat (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Freshchat-leaning ai-customer-service vs LiveChat-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Freshchat — Full ticketing depth lives in Freshdesk — Freshchat is live-chat primary; LiveChat — ChatBot, HelpDesk, and KnowledgeBase are separate Text suite purchases.

Limitations — Freshchat: Full ticketing depth lives in Freshdesk — Freshchat is live-chat primary; Free plan limited to 10 agents; LiveChat: ChatBot, HelpDesk, and KnowledgeBase are separate Text suite purchases; No free plan — trial-only entry.

Poor-fit cases: Freshchat is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Full ticketing depth lives in Freshdesk — Freshchat is live-chat primary · LiveChat is a poor fit when that limitation bites: ChatBot, HelpDesk, and KnowledgeBase are separate Text suite purchases · Avoid Freshchat if you actually need LiveChat's motion (Established live chat from Text — Starter $19, Team $49, Business $79, Enterpris)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
